subject: Interview tomorrow — options after overnight illness
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@example.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Confirming tomorrow — Liam Chen (Final on Backend)

Hi team + Liam,

Quick confirmation for tomorrow's virtual onsite for Liam (10:00–13:00 PT). Agenda and candidate materials attached. Zoom link is below the calendar invite.

Schedule (PT):
- 10:00–10:45 — System design (Connor)
- 11:00–11:45 — Live coding (Grace)
- 12:15–12:45 — Wrap / culture (Naomi)

Attached: Liam_Chen_CV.pdf, backend_interview_guide.pdf, tech_task.zip (exercise for live coding). Please be ready to pivot if anything changes. Liam — ping if you need to adjust times.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@example.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T02:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confirming tomorrow — Liam Chen (Final on Backend)

Hi Marissa / Naomi,

I'm really sorry — I woke up with a fever and bad chills. I've started a telehealth consult and don't think I'll be in good shape for a 3-hour onsite tomorrow. I'm happy to:
- convert to a shorter phone screen today/tomorrow, or
- do the live coding as a take-home (I can submit within 48 hours), or
- reschedule for next week.

If there are any travel reimbursements / taxi receipts needed (I had planned to take a cab tomorrow morning), please let me know — I'm happy to provide receipts if Redwood covers that cost in the reschedule. I really appreciate your flexibility.

Best,
Liam Chen
(liam.chen@example.com)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@example.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T02:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confirming tomorrow — Liam Chen (Final on Backend)

Thanks for the quick note, Liam — I'm sorry to hear you're not feeling well, hope it's minor.

Team — given this is same-day and Liam is in final-stage, I'd like to avoid losing momentum. Options I propose:
1) Convert tomorrow's sessions into a condensed 30–40 minute phone screen + schedule the take-home coding exercise (48-hour turnaround). We can cover system design high-level in the phone screen and evaluate code via the take-home.
2) If someone can pick up the live coding slot on short notice and do it remotely (screen-share + recording), we could keep the schedule but that requires an interviewer with bandwidth to run a 40–50m live exercise.

Grace — are you able to run a shortened coding session tomorrow morning if Liam feels up to it? Connor — if not, I'd be fine moving the live coding to take-home and you can do a follow-up debrief after submission.

Marissa — can you handle the candidate communication and update the calendar if we convert? Also please confirm whether we can reimburse Liam's planned cab (small amount) so he isn't out-of-pocket if we reschedule. If so, loop in Priyom for expense approval.

If Liam prefers to reschedule entirely, that's OK too — let's aim to keep him in the same interview loop rather than restarting.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman | Director, Infrastructure Hiring
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@example.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T02:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confirming tomorrow — Liam Chen (Final on Backend)

On Sun, May 30, 2027 at 2:40 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Grace — are you able to run a shortened coding session tomorrow morning if Liam feels up to it?

I can be flexible. If Liam's not well, let's move the live coding to the take-home and do a 30-minute phone with me + Grace for system design overview and culture fit. That keeps us on track and still gives a strong signal.

Marissa — please convert the 11:00 live coding slot to 'take-home' and put a 30-minute phone at 10:15 PT that I and Grace will take. If Liam submits the take-home within 48 hours, I'll block time to review and give feedback promptly.

Also happy to approve a small reimbursement for taxi (no more than $50) if Priyom signs off.

Connor
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@example.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T03:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confirming tomorrow — Liam Chen (Final on Backend)

Thanks all — Liam, we'll convert as Connor suggested unless you prefer otherwise.

Planned changes I'm pushing now:
- Calendar: 10:15–10:45 PT phone screen (Connor + Grace) — I'll update the invite and remove the 11:00 live coding block.
- Take-home: tech_task.zip will be the live-coding replacement. We'll ask for a 48-hour turnaround; submit via the GH link below.
- Reimbursement: looping in Priyom for a quick sign-off on up to $50 for cab/ride. Liam, please hold on to any receipt and send after you're feeling better.

Greenhouse candidate profile: https://app.greenhouse.io/boards/12345/candidates/67890
Calendar updated: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

Liam — please confirm that the phone window at 10:15 PT works for you or if you'd prefer a different short slot this morning. Also let me know if you want to do the take-home instead and skip the phone.

Appreciate it — hope you recover quickly.

—Marissa
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@example.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T03:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confirming tomorrow — Liam Chen (Final on Backend)

Marissa — approved. Please reimburse up to $50 for Liam's cab if he provides a photo of the receipt and his bank last four for verification. I'll process through ExpenseOps today so he isn't out of pocket.

Also adding a quick note: if Liam submits the take-home, send me a short confirmation when you mark 'take-home received' in GH and I'll expedite the reviewer allocation.

—Priyom
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@example.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T03:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confirming tomorrow — Liam Chen (Final on Backend)

Thanks everyone — plan confirmed: 10:15 PT phone screen (Connor + Grace), live coding converted to take-home with 48-hour window, Priyom approved up to $50 reimbursement. Marissa, please update the GH candidate status to reflect 'take-home assigned' and ping me when it's in.

Liam — wishing you a speedy recovery. When you have a minute, confirm whether you want the phone screen or prefer to do take-home only — we'll accommodate either. If you can, please attach the cab receipt later to this thread or send it to expense@redwood.ai.

—Naomi
